require 'json';require 'digest';require 'open3'
o=File.expand_path(__dir__)
b=JSON.parse(File.read(o+'/memory-controls.json'))
cases=b['rows'].select{|r|r['report']=='dense-dictionary-row-v2' && [40,46].include?(r['index']) && r['mode']=='vm' && r['round']==0}
raise 'coverage' unless cases.size==2
r={status:'running',pid:Process.pid,source_sha256:Digest::SHA256.file(o+'/memory-controls.json').hexdigest,identities:b['identities'],rows:[]}
save=->{File.write(o+'/memory-followup.json.tmp',JSON.pretty_generate(r));File.rename(o+'/memory-followup.json.tmp',o+'/memory-followup.json')};save.call
cases.each do |c|
 %w[vm interpreter jit].product((0...6).to_a).each do |mode,round|
  row={index:c['index'],mode:mode,round:round}
  (round.even? ? %w[baseline candidate] : %w[candidate baseline]).each do |kind|
   argv=c[kind]['argv'].dup;argv += ['--'+mode] unless mode=='vm'
   out,err,status=Open3.capture3(*argv);rss=err.match(/(\d+)\s+maximum resident set size/)
   raise out+err unless status.success? && out==c[kind]['stdout'] && rss
   row[kind]={argv:argv,stdout:out,stderr:err,exit:status.exitstatus,rss_bytes:rss[1].to_i}
  end
  r[:rows]<<row;save.call
 end
end
r[:identities].each{|p,h|raise 'identity drift' unless Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest==h}
r[:status]='measured';save.call
puts '36 additional memory pairs measured; review pending'
